speaker: Warlord Corvane
description: P34 (plan M6-M9 section 2.10, 5.13): Corvane's yield - the yield protocol's two-choice prompt (ui/screens/yield_prompt.gd). Spare (outcome spare) or Strike, which asks again before it counts (outcome strike); the confirm line offers 'No - let me think again' first (M8 gate F7: Strike is never the first choice nor the default). Only these outcomes decide boss.corvane.outcome; the prompt cannot be left without one.

nodes.text: Enough! The Regiment is broken - I yield. Spare my men, giant, and Aldmere will remember it.
Corvane kneels on the keep's steps, his sword at your feet. Strike down a warlord who has yielded?

choices.text: Strike. (There is no taking it back.)

nodes.text: Corvane lowers his head. "Aldmere keeps its word, giant. The fort will not raise arms against you."
The warlord does not rise again.
